name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)

eligibility.other_conditions: Children enrolled in government and government-aided primary (Classes I-V) and upper primary (Classes VI-VIII) schools.

benefits: Free hot cooked nutritious meals conforming to minimum nutritional standards (450 calories & 12g protein for primary, 700 calories & 20g protein for upper primary) every school working day, plus regular nutritional health screening and iron-folic acid supplementation.
documents_required: Bank Account Details of parent/guardian (for direct cooking cost component where applicable)
application_process: Automatic entitlement upon admission to any eligible government or government-aided school.
No separate complex application form required; managed via National PM POSHAN MIS portal by school headmaster.
statutory_citation: National Food Security Act (NFSA) 2013 Section 5(1)(b) & Ministry of Education OM 1-1/2021-Desk(MDM)
benefit_type: Daily Nutritional In-Kind Support & Child Health
